serial.title: Connect over USB
serial.description: Pick the serial port the LumenC3 board is plugged into. It's listed first as "ESP32 (possibly LumenC3)", usually /dev/ttyACM0. Only USB ports not used by other integrations are listed.

network.title: Connect over Wi-Fi
network.description: Boards on the same network are usually found automatically. Enter the address only if yours wasn't — it's printed in the board's log as "Wi-Fi OK: …".

confirm.description:
Set up the LumenC3 at `{address}`?

Over USB, the port is opened to check the device; this may reboot the board.

error.cannot_connect: The device didn't answer. Over USB: check that the port is free (close any serial monitor). Over Wi-Fi: check the address and that the board is online. The board must run LumenC3 firmware with protocol v3 or newer for Wi-Fi (v2 for USB).
error.not_lumenc3: The device at this address is not a LumenC3 (or its firmware is too old).

abort.port_in_use: This port is already used by another integration.
abort.not_lumenc3: The device at this address is not a LumenC3 (or its firmware is too old).
